messages:
Maria Chen: quick async — WIP pulse for api-gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits
What I did: landed small auth header fallback for legacy clients; added metrics for token-mismatch.
Blockers: staging saw intermittent 429s when burst >150 req/s; couldn't repro locally.
Today: will trace burst path and open a small PR to bump default bucket size.

Aj Patel: saw the 429s this morning too — logs point to ratepolicy eval skipping kv cache; can someone file a simple repro? I can take debug.

Sam Ortiz: started a staging run with debug logging on the policy engine. Found a spike at 11:02 where routing table reload delayed ~300ms. Could be causing token-window shifts.

Leo Kim: possible immediate mitigation: increase short window token count from 100 -> 200. Quick config suggestion:
```yaml
rate_limit:
  short_window:
    limit: 200
    window_ms: 1000
```
I can send a canary if people agree.

Rina Sinha: +1 to canary but prefer to do in eu-west first. Also can we add a metric for policy-reload-latency? small PR here: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1234

Maria Chen: good call. @Aj Patel — can you open the canary and coordinate with Sam for logs? I can review Leo's PR tonight.

Aj Patel: on it. Will spin eu-west canary at 11:40 PT. pinging @deploy-bot to start canary.

deploy-bot: @Aj Patel initiated canary: gw-patch/rl-adjust-shortwindow -> eu-west-1 (3 nodes) at 2025-06-19T18:40:12Z :rocket:

Sam Ortiz: added a temporary span in tracing so we can correlate reloads -> 429s: `trace.tag('policy.reload.latency', ms)`. Will remove after verification.

Leo Kim: if canary looks good, I'll PR to roll to prod with 30m ramp.

Rina Sinha: reminder: update the rollout doc with a rollback flag `--no-autoscale` in case capacity shifts.

Maria Chen: blockers cleared for me. Will follow up on the token mismatch metrics. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: can we also add a tiny smoke test to catch policy reload regressions? 1-2 requests with forced reload and verify no 429.

Sam Ortiz: added test stub in repo comments. Will convert to CI job tomorrow.

Leo Kim: filing infra ticket to automate short-window canaries: INF-6789.

Maria Chen: awesome. Closing this pulse — ping if anything breaks.
